meta.scope: Myanmar Batch 5 — Displacement/humanitarian, critical minerals (rare earths, tin, antimony), and education densification under constrained conditions.

candidates.title: Internal displacement and humanitarian needs statistics
candidates.publisher: Derived from OCHA / UN Humanitarian Needs and Response Plan and monitoring sources
candidates.description: Statistics on internal displacement and humanitarian needs. Internally displaced persons are in the multi-million range (approximately 3.7 million cited in recent monitoring); the 2026 Humanitarian Needs and Response Plan projects over 16 million people requiring assistance. Conflict, insecurity and disaster overlays drive large-scale vulnerability.
candidates.notes: High-centrality humanitarian and social-stress node. Distinctive under current conditions.

candidates.title: Rare earths and critical minerals production framing
candidates.publisher: Derived from USGS and trade sources
candidates.description: Framing of rare earths, tin, antimony and related critical-mineral production. Myanmar ranks among the world’s larger producers of rare earths, tin and antimony; much production is artisanal or outside full government control, with China the primary destination.
candidates.notes: Critical-minerals densification complementing gas and jade.

candidates.title: Education and learning outcomes framing
candidates.publisher: Derived from World Bank, UNICEF and national monitoring sources
candidates.description: Framing of education access and learning outcomes. Foundational literacy and numeracy were already weak pre-crisis (very high learning poverty); subsequent disruption has further eroded proficiency and participation.

candidates.title: Myanmar displacement–minerals–education densification meta-node
candidates.publisher: Derived from humanitarian, mineral and education sources
candidates.description: Meta-node binding internal displacement and humanitarian needs, rare earths/critical minerals framing, and education/learning outcomes into a coherent humanitarian–extractive–human-capital residual layer under constrained conditions.
